headline: HCA Healthcare Announces Dr. Michael Schlosser as Executive Vice President and Chief Clinical Officer; Names Charles Gressle President of New Ambulatory Operations Group
summary: NASHVILLE, Tenn., August 06, 2026--HCA Healthcare, Inc. (NYSE:HCA) today announced that Michael Schlosser, M.D., MBA, senior vice president and chief transformation officer, has been appointed executive vice president and chief clinical officer, effective Sept. 1, 2026.
